faq.q: Will my clients know Dadword IT is involved?
faq.a: No. By default we work entirely under your brand. There are no Dadword credits in code, footers, documentation or deliverables, and we only speak to your client if you ask us to.

faq.q: Who owns the code and designs?
faq.a: You do. All code, designs and documentation are transferred to you (or directly to your client) once the work is paid for.

faq.q: How do you price work for agencies?
faq.a: You get partner rates that stay fixed for each engagement. You add your margin and set the price for your client. We never share our rates with your client.

faq.q: Can you join calls with my clients?
faq.a: Yes, if you want us to. We join as part of your team, using your company name and an email alias on your domain.

faq.q: Do you sign NDAs and non-solicitation agreements?
faq.a: Yes. An NDA and a non-solicitation clause are signed before kickoff. We will never approach or pitch your clients.

faq.q: Which time zones do you work with?
faq.a: We are based in India and agree fixed overlap hours with each partner for calls and standups, covering the UK, Europe, Australia and US time zones.
Most partner projects start within one to two weeks of signing, depending on scope. Overflow hours and small tasks can often start sooner.
